description: Every nonempty model of a monadic sentence \(\varphi\), in any Lean universe, makes the finite search accept that sentence.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.decideSentence_complete.{u_1} {k : ℕ} {M : Type u_1}
  [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.lang k).Structure M] [Nonempty M]
  (φ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.lang k).Sentence) (hφ : M ⊨ φ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.decideSentence φ = true
